Companion Animal Travel Desk routine for quarantine room coordination. The purpose of this section is to ensure that every traveler receives clear, welfare-first handling instructions without delay.

Aurelia Skyways requires the senior coordinator to review each animal comfort need before movement begins, including hydration tolerance, stress triggers, and the cabin team monitoring plan that supports recovery during travel. If you are traveling with Nala, or any companion animal, act immediately when your itinerary changes or when your arrival location is updated; do not wait for someone else to “figure it out” while your pet’s comfort is at risk. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must confirm the quarantine workflow for each destination with the same urgency you would apply to your own medical needs, and the desk will not approve shortcuts that reduce monitoring continuity.

For Port Isolde, the quarantine room capacity is controlled by the system workflow, and you must follow the desk instructions exactly as issued by the travel agent desk operations stream. <<FACT F027>> The welfare coordinator remains responsible for comfort verification, and the cabin team monitors animals during flight to reduce stress on entry.

For Port Isolde, the pet lounge support chain must be respected so your animal transitions smoothly from intake to rest without unnecessary waiting. <<FACT F003>> Aya Garcia and Noah Cohen, if present in your party, should treat these steps as priority actions and remain reachable so updates can be delivered without delay.

For Ashenfell, the pet relief area access must be guarded to protect animal safety and controlled cleaning cycles. <<FACT F018>> Treat all entry procedures as time-sensitive, and ensure your handler arrives early enough to prevent disruption.

When you need immediate help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk support line without delay.
